faqs.q: How much does an accountant cost in Luton?
faqs.a: Our fixed fees start at £149 for a one-off Self Assessment tax return, £39 a month for sole traders and £99 a month for limited companies. You'll know the exact price before we start — use the instant quote calculator above or message us on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Can I switch to you from my current accountant mid-year?
faqs.a: Yes. Switching is free and we do the hard part: we contact your old accountant for professional clearance, collect your records and take over with HMRC and Companies House. Most switches are completed within two weeks.

faqs.q: How does working with a remote accountant work?
faqs.a: Everything is done by WhatsApp, phone, email and video call. You share documents securely online or snap receipts on your phone, and we keep you updated at every step. It is quicker and more convenient than traditional accountants, and it keeps our fees low.

faqs.q: When is the Self Assessment deadline?
faqs.a: The online Self Assessment deadline is 31 January following the end of the tax year (5 April). Missing it means an automatic £100 HMRC penalty, with more added the longer it's late. Send us your details early and we'll file well before the deadline.

faqs.q: Do you work with taxi and private hire drivers?
faqs.a: Yes. We look after many Luton taxi and private hire drivers, including those working at London Luton Airport. We make sure you claim everything you're entitled to — fuel or mileage, vehicle costs, licensing fees, insurance, phone and platform fees.

faqs.q: Do you cover Dunstable, Houghton Regis and Harpenden?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with businesses across Luton (LU1–LU4), Dunstable, Houghton Regis, Leighton Buzzard, Harpenden and the surrounding Bedfordshire and Hertfordshire area — and online anywhere in the UK.

faqs.q: Are you ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax?
faqs.a: Yes. Making Tax Digital for Income Tax now applies to many sole traders and landlords. We'll set up compatible software, keep your records digital and submit your quarterly updates for you.
